# Darcy Pattison

> Children's author and indie publishing advocate sharing writing craft, self-publishing strategies, and creative independence for novelists and picture book authors.

Darcy Pattison is an award-winning children's book author, educator, and passionate advocate for indie publishing. The site combines her author bio, writing instruction, publishing guidance, and insights into creative autonomy versus traditional publishing constraints.

## Key Topics

- Darcy Pattison
- Indie publishing
- Self-publishing
- Children's books
- Picture books

- MimsHouseBooks

## About Darcy Pattison

- [Darcy Pattison Updates](https://www.darcypattison.com/darcy-pattison-updates): Darcy Pattison's writing tips and encouragement for novelists and picture book authors.
- [Storyteller](https://www.darcypattison.com/storyteller): Storyteller Darcy Pattison's approach to creating emotionally resonant children's books.
- [Trailblazer](https://www.darcypattison.com/trailblazer): Darcy Pattison's self-publishing journey and award-winning children's book career.
- [Educator](https://www.darcypattison.com/educator): Darcy Pattison teaches picture books, novel revision, and indie publishing.
- [Advocate](https://www.darcypattison.com/advocate): Darcy Pattison advocates for indie publishing and self-published authors.

## Indie Publishing Guides

- [How to Set up an Online Bookstore](https://www.darcypattison.com/publishing/online-bookstore): Guide to setting up an online bookstore with Shopify and LuluXpress for indie publishers.
- [AudioBooks are Growing: Listen Up!](https://www.darcypattison.com/publishing/audiobooks-growing): Audiobook market trends and distribution strategies for indie authors.
- [Indie Means Indie](https://www.darcypattison.com/publishing/indie-means-indie): Darcy Pattison's perspective on indie publishing independence and avoiding Amazon dependency.

## Publishing & Awards

- [When Will a Self-Published Book Win a Major Book Award?](https://www.darcypattison.com/publishing/major-award): Analysis of self-published book eligibility for Newbery, Caldecott, and other major awards.
- [Control Or Creativity?](https://www.darcypattison.com/publishing/control-or-creativity): Darcy Pattison discusses creative autonomy in indie versus traditional publishing.

## Writing & Stories

- [The Wayfinder: YA Fantasy](https://www.darcypattison.com/writing/revision/ya-fantasy): Origin story of THE WAYFINDER YA fantasy novel and THE HEARTLAND SERIES.
